# Golphy — Copilot Instructions

## Stack
React 19, TypeScript, Vite, SCSS modules, Firebase Firestore (JS SDK v12).

## Rules

- Keep the app mobile-first. All new UI must work in portrait mode on a phone without horizontal page scroll. Only table/grid content may scroll horizontally, and only within a constrained container.
- Use sentence case for all UI text: headings, labels, buttons, placeholders, and messages. Capitalize only the first word and proper nouns.
